name: Husqvarna Automower 450X
description: A premium wire-guided robotic mower from Husqvarna's X-line, covering up to 1.25 acres with GPS-assisted navigation, GPS theft tracking, and Alexa/Google Home support. Boundary wire plus GPS-assist — not a wire-free EPOS unit.

specs.label: Subscription
specs.note: Automower Connect app; GPS tracking included

sourcing: Verified against Husqvarna's own official 450X product pages (US/Canada) and an independent Trusted Reviews review. The 450X is a wire-guided model with GPS-assist for efficiency and theft tracking — it is not a wire-free EPOS mower, and should not be confused with the separately-sold "450X NERA" (adds an optional EPOS wire-free module) or with Husqvarna's newer entry-tier "iQ" series. Pricing varies noticeably by retailer/market and by whether professional installation is bundled; Husqvarna's own site was treated as authoritative.

pricing.summary: Husqvarna's own Canadian site lists an MSRP of **$4,299.99** for the 450X. Some third-party retailers advertise a "450X EPOS" bundle in the $2,999–$3,500 range, which appears to be a different or older SKU rather than the current model, so buyers should confirm the exact SKU and treat Husqvarna's own site as authoritative.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: The 450X combines a physical boundary wire with GPS-assisted navigation, plus GPS theft tracking, GeoFence alerts, and PIN protection. It's IPX4-rated, using a "Weather Timer" that adjusts mowing frequency to grass growth, with Alexa/Google Home app connectivity. Reviewers praised slope handling but noted its razor-blade cutter doesn't mulch leaves or twigs, and professional installation is nearly mandatory.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: The 450X is a wire-guided model with GPS-assist for efficiency and anti-theft tracking, not a wire-free EPOS mower — it shouldn't be confused with the separately-sold "450X NERA" or Husqvarna's newer entry-tier "iQ" series. Husqvarna's own Canadian site lists an MSRP of $4,299.99, while some third-party retailers advertise a "450X EPOS" bundle at $2,999–$3,500 that appears to be a different or older SKU.

firmwareCommunity.note: Husqvarna Automower 450X has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
